[[Nicholas the Traveler]] | commonsalvage = 1 [[Bone]] | raresalvage = 1 [[Monstrous Claw]] | render = [[File:Trophy Fangs.jpg|120px]] }} [[Keen Oni Talon]] are [[item]]s dropped by [[Oni]] in [[the Jade Sea]]. ==Acquisition== * [[Guild Wars Factions|Factions]] ** [[The Jade Sea]] *** [[Oni]] ''Drop and salvage research is ongoing, and can be found [[Talk:Keen Oni Talon#Drop research|here]].'' ===Farming=== ==== [[Rhea's Crater]] ==== [[File:Keen Oni Talon farming Rhea's Crater.jpg|300px]] A party of 4 is enough. You can find 23 [[Oni]] in one run which can take about 15 minutes. You should get 1-2 Oni Talons per run. ==== [[Silent Surf]] ==== [[File:Keen oni talon silent surf.jpg]] Upon leaving [[Seafarer's Rest]], go through the opening in the wall and head south along the edge of the map. When you reach the pit on your left, 3-4 Oni will spawn. Each run should only take around a minute so perhaps consider [[anti-farm code]] countermeasures such as waiting a little after zoning or killing another group first. ==Collectors== {{:Dauv Merishahl/Collector}} {{:Nicholas the Traveler/Collector|9th August 2010 and 7th January 2013|Silent Surf|1 [[Keen Oni Talon]]}} ==Notes== *The collector [[Dauv Merishahl]] trades 2 Keen Oni Talons for items that sell for 125 {{gold}} to a merchant. This provides a return that is two and a half times more than just selling the trophies by themselves.
